query:
UPDATE exercise_repositories
SET status = CASE
    WHEN sync_requested_at > sync_started_at THEN 'pending'
    ELSE 'success'
  END::exercise_repository_status,
  sync_started_at = NULL,
  sync_attempts = 0,
  error_message = NULL,
  last_synced_at = now(),
  last_sync_report = $3
WHERE id = $1
  AND sync_started_at = $2
